environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with no additional network restrictions. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://api.acmecorp.com/profile. Authentication is cookie-based with SameSite=None on the session cookie to support cross-subdomain requests. No WAF is attached to the API Gateway stage. The Lambda function URL is not used; all traffic routes through API Gateway which forwards all headers including Cookie and Origin without filtering.

config.cors: Access-Control-Allow-Origin set in Lambda response only
